documentation.content:
A job failed, or the heartbeat reported a problem.

What fired this: jobs/runner.py logs every job failure at ERROR with structured fields. The `error` field says which kind:
  auth_expired  - could not authenticate to the platform (see docs/platform-auth.md)
  oom           - the OOM killer took the subprocess (SIGKILL / returncode -9)
  timeout       - exceeded the job type's ceiling in jobs/types.py
  runner_died   - reaped on startup after the runner was killed mid-run
  exit_N        - the CLI exited non-zero for some other reason

Triage:
  1. Logs Explorer: log_id("foresight_runner") AND severity>=ERROR
  2. The entry's jsonPayload.record.extra.log_file names the run's OWN log,
     which holds the reason. The runner only ever sees an exit code.
  3. Open it: labels."agent.googleapis.com/log_file_path"=~"<log_file>"

For auth_expired specifically:
  python -m cli auth status -t <tenant>
  python -m cli auth probe <platform> -t <tenant>

conditions.displayName: Any ERROR from the job runner
